title: Captive Hearts
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Megumi Kuroishi's family has lived comfortably on the Kogami family's fortune since the Kogamis vanished in China. When Suzuka Kogami is found in a rural Chinese village, Megumi learns that a curse compels his family to obey hers, and a romance grows out of the forced master-servant bond (VIZ blurb; School Library Journal review). The five volumes also include short stories, one about mutual feelings between a teacher and a student that stay non-physical (SLJ).
life_message: Love chosen freely matters more than an inherited bond or a curse.

content.note: A family curse compels obedience; light supernatural drama (VIZ blurb; MU Curse/s).
Main romance between Megumi and Suzuka; a bonus story about shared teacher-student feelings, nothing physical (SLJ). AniList Age Gap tag is low-ranked.
Compelled servitude played for comedy (MU Master-Servant, Slavery categories; SLJ).
